user.title: Add emulated WiFi sensor for Venstar
user.description: Select the Home Assistant network interface that can reach the thermostat and choose the emulated sensor details. On the next screen, start pairing from Home Assistant first, then add the wireless sensor from the thermostat menu.

data_description.source_interface: Choose the interface that can reach the thermostat.
data_description.unicast_target: Only needed when Mode is Unicast. Leave empty for Broadcast mode.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: Broadcast mode does not need a thermostat IP and requires the thermostat to be on the same subnet as the selected interface. Unicast mode requires Thermostat IP and can reach a thermostat on another routed subnet if the Home Assistant host/container can route to it.

pair_ready.title: Ready to pair?
pair_ready.description: Press Pair to start sending pairing packets from Home Assistant. After pairing has started, use the thermostat menu to add a new wireless sensor.

pairing_active.title: Pairing in progress
pairing_active.description: Pairing packets are being sent. Use the thermostat menu to add a new wireless sensor now. Remaining timeout: {remaining_seconds}s.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure emulated sensor
reconfigure.description: Only non-identity fields are editable after creation.
